html:
This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers will experience the vibrant city life of Ho Chi Minh City, the sand dunes and fishing villages of Mui Ne, the unique waterways and local lifestyle of the Mekong Delta, and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. The tour includes private transportation, English speaking guides, local meals, and comfortable three-star accommodation.

HO CHI MINH CITY – MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – CU CHI TOUR

Price: 338 USD per person

Based on a group of two people

DETAILED ITINERARY

DAY 1: MUI NE SUNSET TOUR

Lunch included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the airport and transfer to Mui Ne.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Check in at the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Fairy Stream, a spectacular natural site with vibrant orange-red stream water and unique sand formations.

Observe the daily life of fishermen at the Mui Ne Fishing Village. Boats return from the sea, women sort the catch, and the atmosphere reflects traditional coastal life.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, which offer excellent photography opportunities with their striking red sand and gentle slopes.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant. Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 2: MUI NE SUNRISE TOUR – HO CHI MINH CITY

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour at White Sand Dunes. Optional activities include quad bike rides, ostrich riding, and sand sliding (at personal expense).

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time for swimming or relaxing at the resort.

Midday

Check out at 12:00 PM and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

Check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City at 05:00 PM. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

DAY 3: MEKONG DELTA TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:15 AM, depart from Ho Chi Minh City for My Tho city by private car.

Board a motorboat at the pier and cruise along the Mekong River. Observe floating houses and local fish farming activities.

Continue to Thoi Son Islet (Unicorn Island) and take a horse cart to a performance site to enjoy traditional Vietnamese music, “Đàn Ca Tài Tử,” recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Seasonal tropical fruits will also be served.

Take a small hand-rowing boat along a creek lined with coconut trees to experience the Mekong Delta lifestyle. Visit a local bee farm and enjoy honey tea.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Visit a coconut candy workshop and sample freshly made candies.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car. Free evening.

DAY 4: CU CHI TUNNELS – HO CHI MINH CITY CITY TOUR

Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:30 AM, depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, approximately 60 kilometers from Ho Chi Minh City. Explore the extensive tunnel network used during the Vietnam War and learn about the history of the region. Optional shooting experience with rifles is available.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City and enjoy a city tour: visit Ho Chi Minh City Hall, Nguyen Hue Walking Street, and Coffee Apartment for local coffee.

Visit the Pink Church, famous for its unique architecture and striking pink color.

Continue to Saigon Central Post Office, one of Asia’s grandest post offices. Learn about Vietnam’s cultural history and try sending mail the traditional way.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

DAY 5: DEPARTURE

Breakfast included

Depending on your flight schedule, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport. The tour ends.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

  • Private car pickup and drop off

  • English speaking tour guide

  • Four local lunches

  • Entrance tickets to all attractions

  • Four nights accommodation in three-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat ride

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

  • Jeep service at sand dunes

  • Value added tax

  • Personal expenses

  • Visa fees
